answer: We enforce a cryptoeconomic system where identities require staking collateral and a sequential thread of zero-knowledge verifiable delay. This design establishes a cryptographic haven for honest nodes. Because the opportunity-cost of generating these sequential proofs scales superlinearly, any Sybil multiplication attempt forces the adversary's expected utility to become strictly negative upon the payoff knoll. Thus, dynamic slashing rules guarantee that the honest profile remains a subgame-perfect Nash equilibrium.
